## 同樣支援護甲紋飾！！

![帶有紋飾的各式護甲並排顯示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/5391305e35c64f7bd8c16b05cc5653d1a7c716d8.png)

### 
<details>
<summary>🥕進食動畫！！！🥕[1.21.4+]</summary>

![食物與其對應的動畫](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/o962rBDR/images/1f7ab4d15103c2c2f758ccf37d72e2d5593ec192.gif)

</details>

<details>
<summary>⚔️物品⚔️</summary>



- [全新的鑽石與下界合金工具](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/38b0b73f4dc13427cccc61812cc48c116ea47160.png)
- 更深的下界合金色調
- 全新造型的三叉戟
- 更深的桶子顏色（開發中）
- 來自 [VanillaTweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/) 的 2D 床設計

</details>






<details>
<summary>👀低干擾設計👀</summary>

- 移除魚漂
- [降低盾牌高度](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/ba3bfd3e45aeb48e7aea4fc05177f78a2aee88a0.png)
- [降低火焰高度](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/ba3bfd3e45aeb48e7aea4fc05177f78a2aee88a0.png)
- [縮小圖騰（1.21.4+ 僅在副手持有時才會縮小）](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/d506b6a37ba2d645fdc55a737228df44a519b37c.png)
- 移除暗角效果
- 移除南瓜頭遮罩
- 來自 [VanillaTweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/) 的低干擾附魔光效
- 移除掃擊與重擊粒子效果




</details>


<details>
<summary>🩷粉紅受擊畫面偏移🩷</summary>

![史蒂夫受到傷害時的畫面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/77f7580c754dfc9dbe88d1ddb7d86ae7b56eab62.png)

</details>
